subject.title: Telegram voice message delayed ~15 minutes before agent dispatch, then run aborts

question: Should this issue remain open as the combined Telegram voice dispatch-latency plus aborted/no-reply tracker after the v2026.6.11 ingress fixes, or should maintainers split/close it in favor of narrower follow-ups?
rationale: Current main has shipped general ingress recovery improvements, but the exact voice-note source timestamp delay and aborted/no-visible-reply behavior still need live proof and product choices around watchdog thresholds and fallback text.

options.title: Keep combined tracker open
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-owned live Telegram voice repro and a narrow decision on source-age diagnostics plus abort/no-reply fallback behavior.

options.title: Split remaining work
options.body: Close or supersede this only after explicitly linking the delayed-ingress portion to shipped fixes and the remaining voice/no-reply portion to a canonical open issue.

options.title: Treat shipped ingress fixes as enough
options.body: Close as implemented only if maintainers accept that the central user problem was the generic ingress-spool delay and do not want a separate voice abort fallback.

recommendation.title: Keep combined tracker open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-owned live Telegram voice repro and a narrow decision on source-age diagnostics plus abort/no-reply fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent stalled-ingress recovery work is the closest merged history for the partially fixed dispatch-delay surface.
